hero.paragraph: We work with local authorities, the NHS and the Voluntary Community, Faith and Social Enterprise (VCFSE) sector to co-create fairer, healthier early years systems — built on evidence, creativity and authentic collaboration.
hero.imageAlt: A woman crouches on sunlit grass in a park, steadying a toddler in a yellow checked shirt

mission.heading: Every baby and child deserves the best childhood
paragraphs: At Childhood is Now, we believe that every child deserves the best start in life, and that means listening deeply, acting early and building creative solutions together that last.

We know that the everyday decisions made by local systems shape all children's earliest experiences, but the consequences of those decisions are felt most greatly by children growing up in underserved communities or challenging circumstances.
mission.imageAlt: A mother smiling down at her baby, carried close in a sling

missionQuote.quote: Our mission is to work in partnership and combine evidence, creativity, and authentic collaboration to reduce inequalities and to deliver lasting impact for young children.

items.title: Early Years system review
items.body: Design and improve early years strategies, services and systems that are equity-focused, evidence-informed and rooted in lived experience.

items.title: Best Start in Life and Healthy Babies plans
items.body: Bring partners together across sectors to work collaboratively on developing a shared vision and outcomes for babies and young children.

items.title: Codesign and participation
items.body: Embed co-design and participation to ensure families and communities shape the decisions that affect them.

items.title: Evidence into action
items.body: Translate evidence into action, combining research, learnt and lived experience, data and practical, real-world delivery.

cta.heading: Let's build change that lasts
cta.paragraph: Whether you're from a local authority, the NHS, or a voluntary sector partner, we'd love to hear from you.
